notes.title: Development Notes #02
notes.content:
Good day, gentlemen!

We'd like to update you on the latest development progress of Hana Street Mangoya, and welcome any suggestions in the discussion forum. 

[h1]Feature Update[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/41f5e896e44fb17f07a2ab6818cb3dc798ce1b04.png[/img]

In view of the player's response that the operation of the battle is  a little inconvenient, so recently for the battle operation, especially the way to switch skills to make adjustments

As shown above, just click on the skill name and the three skills you are carrying will pop up for you to choose

[h1]New Kanban girl function[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/5b545d895e7697535865323a10beff2cc99b6e05.png[/img]
If you have downloaded the new DEMO version of the gentleman should be able to see the Kanban girl function, in addition to the Kanban girl  role can be switched, the background can also be switched, click on the Kanban girl  will also have a voice, hope you like!

[h1]New language[/h1]
Russian is currently added to the game, and other languages are expected to be added one after another, but since the team is relatively small, the addition of new languages can only be done slowly, so please forgive me!

[h1]Introduction[/h1]
You are an assassin with extraordinary skills. live in seclusion in an inconspicuous mansion on Flower Street and work in the Nandemoya. Your life is actually pretty good by yourself, but the little sister next door comes to visit you all day long. You are a legendary assassin, you originally dismissed the girl's request, but...so big! This little sister's breasts are really big!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
Freely create your own fighting style, find the right target on the busy street and knock it down. As long as you complete the girl's commission, you can get the intimate reward you are eager for.

[h3]Game Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dynamic CG
[*]Rich storyline
[*]Female characters with different personalities
[*]Matching Skills
[*]Exciting strategic battles
[*]Some Japanese dubbing
[/list]

notes.title: Development Notes #01
notes.content:
I'd like to report on the recent development progress of "Nandemoya of Flower Street" . Any suggestions are also welcome to discuss in the discussion forum 

[h1]Feature Updates[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/75f74028e80964a0e644c5a06e3e92cafab6b3cb.png[/img]

The auto-battle feature is now complete! After entering the battle, just press the "auto button" at the bottom right.
But whether you can successfully pass the level or depends on the skill arrangement of each character, the game is expected to provide two modes: normal and hard, the hard mode is quite brain-dead oh! 

[h1]Boss is unwilling to be lonely and wants to make an appearance[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/8269dfe3e6288e901522012c2e8bf316a63d14ac.png[/img]

In order to make the battle screen more powerful, recently also successfully let the boss can be in the appearance of the dynamic stance from the sky.
In fact, this feature has always wanted to do, but because there are other important systems have to be completed first, so the boss can only be left out until now.


[h1]Entrustment Release[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/f47c9c2e209e1e5a14abd10821ca723f7239c59a.png[/img]
In order not to interfere with the main plot, every major Entrustment in the game exists as a side story. Mizuho will be the first Entrustment the players will encounter. Mizuho's character trait is a married woman, so... yes, we will be cheating on her. We hope everyone will enjoy it.
Mizuho is also the tallest of all the female characters. After all, she is the wife of a wealthy family, so she naturally has a tall and graceful model body. Due to her shy personality, her Japanese voice acting is also very soft, creating a strong contrast with her hidden personality.
